builds.title: Into Scorpions
builds.blurb: Fast Castle at about 25 villagers, then Siege Workshops and Scorpions backed by spearmen and rams.

builds.title: Archers: Dark Age to two ranges
builds.blurb: From the first villagers to the second Archery Range. The Dark Age part and the villager split come from his 2 own recordings (Arabia 3v3 and Golden Pit 4v4); the other recordings are less reliable for that.

builds.title: Arena fast Castle boom
builds.blurb: Feudal at about 23 villagers, Castle at 25, then two or three extra Town Centers. No army before Castle; the military buildings come around 21 to 25 minutes. His archer games as Vietnamese are on MegaRandom and African Clearing instead.
